items.title: Johnny Lala Interview, 1958-09-24
items.q: Jules and I all keep together.

ctx.x: Ray Lopez had told me his father was a good violin player. He was in the French Opera orchestra. Yes, in the violin player, I think. I think he played trumpet, too. I don't know. I played something. I'm not real sure. No, I was.
Tell me something. Is Jules Casdard living yet?
Yes. Yes. He travels with the races or something.
